notes: L1 `import { cn } from '@/lib/cn'` -> dropped: cn is clsx + tailwind-merge, a Tailwind/DOM-only class composer with no RN analog; replaced by a React Native StyleSheet + theme tokens (the FSMStateDiagram / EmptyState parity precedent). L2 `import { getStateColor } from '@/types/fsm'` -> inlined: that module is not yet ported (own conversion slots), so — following the sibling FSMStateDiagram port — getStateColor is reproduced verbatim in semantics. The web returns Tailwind classes (`.bg`/`.text`/`.dot`); the native resolver returns the literal hex/rgba each class maps to (LocationsPage exact-hex precedent). StateBadge consumes ALL THREE channels (.bg + .text + .dot), so all three are resolved here (FSMStateDiagram needed only .dot + .text). Every per-state `overrides` from the eight source FSM files is pre-applied.

Inlined registry fidelity: each state's {bg,text,dot} = VARIANT_THEME[variant] merged with the state's `overrides`. The `.text` + `.dot` channels were cross-checked to match the already-shipped FSMStateDiagram native port exactly (vehicle.charging cyan-400, vehicle.parked purple-400, vehicle.asleep gray-400 dot + muted text, vehicle.offline gray-500 dot + muted text, command/notification/automation gave_up & notification.dead red-500, automation.idle text-secondary, automation.skipped gray-500 dot + muted text, automation.disabled red-400/50 -> rgba(248,113,113,0.5)). The added `.bg` channel resolves each Tailwind `{color}-500/10` (and the `-600/10` for *_gave_up/dead, `-500/5` for automation.disabled, `gray-600/10` for offline/skipped) to its matching alpha rgba: green rgba(34,197,94,0.1), amber rgba(245,158,11,0.1), red rgba(239,68,68,0.1), red/5 rgba(239,68,68,0.05), red-600 rgba(220,38,38,0.1), blue rgba(59,130,246,0.1), cyan rgba(6,182,212,0.1), purple rgba(168,85,247,0.1), indigo rgba(99,102,241,0.1), orange rgba(249,115,22,0.1), gray rgba(107,114,128,0.1), gray-600 rgba(75,85,99,0.1). getStateColor keeps source semantics: unknown fsmType -> vehicle table, unknown state -> neutral DEFAULT_STATE (gray-500/10 bg, muted text, gray-400 dot), state matched via toLowerCase().
L3 blank line preserved as section separation. L4-7 `interface StateBadgeProps { state: string; fsmType: string }` ported verbatim (same names, same string types). L8 blank line preserved.

L9 `export function StateBadge({ state, fsmType }: StateBadgeProps) {` preserved exactly — named export, identical destructured props, no default export added (displayName added, matching the FSMStateDiagram / EmptyState parity precedent). L10 `const color = getStateColor(fsmType, state)` preserved verbatim against the inlined resolver.

L11-18 `return (<span className={cn('inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium', color.bg, color.text)}>` -> `return (<View style={[styles.badge, {backgroundColor: color.bg}]}>`: inline-flex -> row View with alignSelf 'flex-start' (shrink-to-content pill); items-center -> alignItems 'center'; gap-1.5 -> gap 6; px-2 -> paddingHorizontal 8; py-0.5 -> paddingVertical 2; rounded-full -> borderRadius 9999; color.bg -> dynamic backgroundColor. The text-xs/font-medium + color.text portion of the span className is carried onto the label AppText (L20) because RN text color/size must live on the Text node (it inherits to the span's text child in HTML).

L19 `<span className={cn('h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full', color.dot)} />` -> `<View style={[styles.dot, {backgroundColor: color.dot}]} />`: h-1.5 w-1.5 -> 6x6; rounded-full -> borderRadius 3 (full circle for a 6px box); color.dot -> dynamic backgroundColor.

L20 `{state}` -> `{state}`: the bare text child becomes an AppText carrying the pill's text-xs (fontSize 12) + font-medium (fontWeight '500') typography and the dynamic color.text. L21 `` -> ``. L22 `)` and L23 `}` (function close) preserved. Source trailing newline (file L24) is the EOF newline, not a code line.

Native-safe substitutions (rules 4-7): @/lib/cn -> StyleSheet + tokens; @/types/fsm getStateColor -> inlined bg/text/dot resolver (8 FSMs, exact Tailwind hex/rgba); DOM <span> pill + <span> dot -> View + View/AppText; inline-flex -> alignSelf flex-start row; text className -> AppText label color/size. No DOM elements, Tailwind/cn, react-i18next, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI-kit modules are imported into the native output.
